metadata.question: Does forest cover decrease in Argentina's Salta Province from December 2000 to December 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS data (MOD44B - Vegetation Continuous Fields) has forest cover data from 2000 onwards at ~250m resolution, or use Hansen Global Forest Cover dataset which has annual change data from 2000-2023. - Dates: December 2000 vs December 2019 (or closest available annual data for those years) - Location: Salta Province, Argentina (need to define polygon) 2. Masking strategy: - For forest cover datasets, cloud masking is already built-in. No additional masking needed. - Hansen dataset provides forest loss, forest gain, and tree cover % - perfect for comparison. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid Zero: Forest cover is 0% in an area (answer could be A or B based on comparison) - Null/Error: Data missing for the time period, invalid values (e.g., >100%), or calculation returns None - C1: No images found for either 2000 or 2019 - C2: No valid pixels after filtering (unlikely for this dataset) - C3: Calculation returns invalid values or None ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Salta Province, Argentina geometry const saltaProvince = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Salta')); const geometry = saltaProvince.geometry(); // 2. Load Hansen Global Forest Change dataset const hansenData = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_10'); // 3. Extract forest cover for year 2000 and 2019 // treecover2000 = % tree cover in 2000 const treecover2000 = hansenData.select('treecover2000'); // lossyear band: year of loss (1=2001, 2=2002, ..., 19=2019) // Create forest cover for 2019 by removing areas that lost forest by 2019 const lossYear = hansenData.select('loss').eq(1); const lossYearValue = hansenData.select('lossyear'); // Forest cover 2019 = treecover2000 - areas lost by 2019 // Areas lost by 2019 have lossyear values 1-19 const forestLoss2000to2019 = treecover2000.mask(lossYear).updateMask(lossYearValue.lte(19)); // 4. Calculate mean forest cover in 2000 const cover2000 = treecover2000.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const cover2000Value = cover2000.get('treecover2000').getInfo(); // 5. Calculate total forest loss from 2000 to 2019 const lossArea = hansenData.select('loss_area').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const lossAreaValue = lossArea.get('loss_area').getInfo(); // 6. Get pixel count of valid data const validPixels2000 = treecover2000.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const validPixelsValue = validPixels2000.get('treecover2000').getInfo(); // 7. Validation and output console.log(`Salta Province Analysis 2000-2019:`); console.log(`Forest Cover 2000: ${cover2000Value !== null ? cover2000Value.toFixed(2) : 'N/A'}%`); console.log(`Forest Loss 2000-2019: ${lossAreaValue !== null ? lossAreaValue.toFixed(0) : 'N/A'} hectares`); console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${validPixelsValue}`); // 8. Determine answer if (validPixelsValue === null || validPixelsValue === 0) { console.log('C2'); } else if (cover2000Value === null || lossAreaValue === null) { console.log('C3'); } else if (lossAreaValue > 0) { // Forest loss occurred = forest cover decreased console.log('A'); } else { // No forest loss = forest cover did not decrease console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
